about: What `fast-test` runs for a change (see ~/Code/fast-test). Portal builds and tests on this computer only (AGENTS.md): every step runs here, there is no Beast part. The real-boundary scripts lease their own fixtures through agent-resource.

steps.name: portal
steps.about: Clippy and the unit tests of the desktop app (the contract-backed tests read hub/contracts).
steps.run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --lib --test validation_tests

steps.name: hub
steps.about: Clippy and tests of Portal Hub, in the dev shell (its runtime tests need dtach and sshd).
steps.run: nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' develop --command sh -c 'cargo clippy --locked -p portal-hub --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked -p portal-hub'

steps.name: hub-container
steps.about: The container smoke test, through its own leased route, when the image or that test changed.

steps.name: hub-real
steps.about: A real-boundary script (leased fixtures) when that script itself changed; otherwise run them by hand.
steps.run: for f in {files}; do python3 "$f" || exit 1; done
